title: Ghost wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='ghostGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8c8e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hatGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d02048'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M28 78 Q28 30 50 30 Q72 30 72 78
           Q72 86 66 86 Q61 86 60 80 Q58 74 53 74
           Q48 74 46 80 Q44 86 39 86 Q34 86 33 80
           Q32 74 28 78 Z'
        fill='url(#ghostGrad)'/>
  <!-- ghost body shading edge (lighter contrast) -->
  <path d='M28 78 Q28 30 50 30 Q72 30 72 78
           Q72 86 66 86 Q61 86 60 80 Q58 74 53 74
           Q48 74 46 80 Q44 86 39 86 Q34 86 33 80
           Q32 74 28 78 Z'
        fill='none' stroke='#cfe2f5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='56' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='56' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='54' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='54' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='64' r='3' fill='#ffb0c8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='64' r='3' fill='#ffb0c8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M38 32 L50 6 L62 32 Z' fill='url(#hatGrad)'/>
  <path d='M38 32 L50 6 L62 32 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M42 25 L58 25' stroke='#ffe14a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M45 18 L55 18' stroke='#ffe14a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hat pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='4' fill='#ffe14a'/>
  <!-- hat brim band -->
  <rect x='37' y='30' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe14a'/>
</svg>
